calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year 
FROM dim_date 
WHERE calendar_date >= '2024-01-01'
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  d.fiscal_period_label,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB' 
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, MIN(d.calendar_date) as period_start, MAX(d.calendar_date) as period_end
FROM dim_date d
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN 'Member' ELSE 'Non-member' END as member_status,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB' 
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, member_status
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, member_status

SELECT COUNT(*) as web_sales_count, MIN(d.calendar_date) as first_date, MAX(d.calendar_date) as last_date
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB' 
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'

SELECT COUNT(*) as web_sales_count, MIN(d.calendar_date) as first_date, MAX(d.calendar_date) as last_date
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB' 
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'

  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / 
    SUM(f.net_amount) * 100,
    2
  ) as member_share_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB' 
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / 
    SUM(f.net_amount) * 100,
    2
  ) as member_share_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB' 
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
